 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Prateek Jalan
 Order
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

1. By way of this petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the petitioner seeks to quash FIR No. 39/2025, dated 24.03.2025, registered under Sections 409/420/467/468/471/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, lodged at P.S. Economic Offences Wing, Delhi. .

2. Mr. Suyash Sinha, learned counsel for the petitioner, states that, against the same FIR [FIR No.
39/2025, lodged at P.S. Economic Offences Wing] another petition has been filed by co-accused Sanjeev Malhotra [CRL.M.C. 9184/2025], in which this Court has issued notice on 22.12.2025.
The said petition is scheduled to be listed on 06.07.2026.
3. Issue notice.
Mr. Yasir Rauf Ansari, learned Additional Standing This is a digitally signed order.
